dungeon.description:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.

raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.

heroTalents.description: Void Torrent can be used while moving. While Entropic Rift is active, you move 20% faster.

heroTalents.description:
Entropic Rift upgrades Mind Blast into Void Blast while it is active.

Void Blast:
Sends a blast of cosmic void energy at the enemy, causing 39,089 Shadow damage.

Generates 8 Insanity.

heroTalents.description: Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain deal 20% additional damage.
heroTalents.name: Inner Quietus

heroTalents.description: While Entropic Rift is active, your Shadow damage is increased by 5%.

heroTalents.description: Shadow Word: Death consumes absorb shields from your target, dealing 42,078 extra damage to them and granting you 5 Insanity if a shield was present.
heroTalents.name: Devour Matter

heroTalents.description: Void Blast increases the duration of Entropic Rift by 1.0 sec, up to a maximum of 3 sec.
heroTalents.name: Darkening Horizon

heroTalents.description:
When Entropic Rift ends, a Voidwraith is summoned from the collapsed rift for 6 sec.

Voidwraith
Summon a Voidwraith that casts Void Flay from afar. Void Flay deals bonus damage to high health enemies, up to a maximum of 50% if they are full health.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Voidwraith attacks.
heroTalents.name: Voidwraith

heroTalents.description: Voidheart now persists for 8 sec after Entropic Rift ends.
heroTalents.name: Touch of the Void

heroTalents.description: Shadow Word: Pain and Entropic Rift deal damage 15% more often.
heroTalents.name: Quickened Pulse

heroTalents.description: Void Blast generates 2 additional Insanity.

heroTalents.description: Void Torrent deals 30% increased damage.

heroTalents.description:
Each time you cast Shadow Word: Madness, Entropic Rift is empowered, increasing its damage and size by 20%.

After Entropic Rift ends it collapses, dealing 22,451 Shadow damage split amongst enemy targets within 15 yds.
heroTalents.name: Collapsing Void

specTalents.description:
A word of madness haunts the target's mind, dealing 11,124 Shadow damage instantly plus an additional 46,034 Shadow damage over 6 sec. Heals you for 30% of damage dealt.

When reapplied to a target, all remaining damage is added to the new effect.
specTalents.name: Shadow Word: Madness

specTalents.description:
Your direct damage spells inflict 20% of their damage on all other targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch within 40 yards.

Does not apply to damage from Shadowy Apparitions, Shadow Word: Pain, and Vampiric Touch.

specTalents.description: Shadow Word: Pain deals 150% increased damage.

specTalents.description: Dispersion heals you for an additional 25% of your maximum health over its duration and its cooldown is reduced by 30 sec.

specTalents.description:

Applies Vampiric Touch to up to 6 enemies, prioritizing ones without Vampiric Touch.

Generates 6 Insanity.
specTalents.name: Tentacle Slam

specTalents.description: Shadow Word: Madness conjures Shadowy Apparitions that float towards all targets afflicted by your Vampiric Touch for 4,613 Shadow damage.
specTalents.name: Shadowy Apparitions

specTalents.description: Increases Shadow Word: Madness damage by 15%.
specTalents.name: Tormenting Whispers

specTalents.description: Increases Tentacle Slam damage by 300%.

specTalents.description: Mind Flay damage increased by 15% and Insanity generation increased by 30%.
specTalents.name: Surge of Insanity

specTalents.description: Shadow Word: Pain periodic damage has a chance to cause your next Mind Blast to be instant and ignore its cooldown.
specTalents.name: Shadowy Insight

specTalents.description: Increases your Shadow Word: Madness damage by 6% and increases your maximum Insanity by 50.
specTalents.name: Voidtouched

specTalents.description:
Bombards your target with a Void Volley and twists your Shadowform with void magic, increasing your spell damage by 25% for 20 sec. 

During Voidform, Void Volley replaces this spell and can be used up to 5 times.

 Void Volley
Releases a volley of pure void energy, firing 10 bolts at your target and 1 bolt at all enemies within 10 yards of your target for 3,529 Shadow damage.

Generates 10 Insanity.
specTalents.name: Voidform

specTalents.description:
Shadowy Apparition damage increased by 10%.

When Shadowy Apparitions deal damage, they extend the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch on the target by 1.0 sec.
specTalents.name: Haunting Shadows

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Mind Flay by 25%.
specTalents.name: Mental Decay

specTalents.description:

 Shadowfiend
Summons a Shadowfiend to attack your target for 6 sec.

Generates 1 Insanity each time the Shadowfiend attacks.
specTalents.name: Shadowfiend

specTalents.description: Vampiric Touch deals 20% additional damage and has a chance to generate 1 Insanity each time it deals damage.
specTalents.name: Maddening Touch

specTalents.description:
Shadow Word: Madness increases your haste during Voidform by 2% and increases its duration by 1.5 sec, stacking up to 5 times. 

When Voidform ends, the haste lingers and decays over 10 sec.
specTalents.name: Ancient Madness

specTalents.description:
Shadowy Apparitions that float towards your primary target explode, dealing 4,917 Shadow damage to all enemies within 8 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 5 targets.
specTalents.name: Shadeburst

specTalents.description: Increases your periodic spell damage by 6%.

specTalents.description: Summoned minions last 20% longer and deal an additional 15% damage.

specTalents.description:
Tentacle Slam deals 50% increased damage and Void Volley deals 15% increased damage.

When Voidform ends, you can cast Void Volley 1 additional time within 30 sec.
specTalents.name: Crushing Void

specTalents.description:
Tentacle Slam has a 100% chance to activate an effect from one of your Idols.

 Idol of Y'Shaarj
Summons a Shadowfiend.

 Idol of N'Zoth
Your target witnesses a nightmare or vision of N'Zoth.

 Idol of Yogg-Saron
Summons a Thing From Beyond.

 Idol of C'Thun
Summons a Void Tendril or Void Lasher.
specTalents.name: Void Apparitions

specTalents.description:
Shadowy Apparitions have a 60% chance to spawn as Void Apparitions that release a Void Bolt at their target and deal 50% increased damage.

 Void Bolt
Sends a bolt of pure void energy at your target, dealing 5,581 Shadow damage.

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

dungeon.description:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.
dungeon.name: Kings' Rest
